region: Wallonia, municipalities intersecting EMSR518 AOI01/AOI02 (MONIT01 products)
municipality_boundaries: Eurostat GISCO LAU 2021 (external), clipped to EMS areas of interest
assumptions: A building is 'in a modelled flood cell' when its OBAT centroid lies in an EFAS cell (~90 m) with depth > 0, or inside the EMS observed extent for 2021. Depths are cell values, not depths at the building.
EFAS models larger rivers only: small streams and surface runoff are not covered. Where EFAS has no flood cell in a municipality, 0 means 'not modelled', not 'no risk'.
EFAS maps are treated as undefended hazard: the README does not mention flood defences, and the literature (Dottori et al. 2022, ESSD) describes local defences as not represented.
Depths above 10 m are flagged as likely river-channel cells or artefacts and left out of the deep-water counts.
OBAT heights are 100 m cell averages with a 2.5 m minimum; buildings at that minimum have an uncertain height.
Permanent water (EMS hydrography: rivers, lakes, reservoirs) is removed from all flood extents.
The EMS 2021 extent is satellite-detected only (radar on 15 and 17 July 2021) and is a lower bound; it captured almost none of the Vesdre valley flooding.
efas_depth_unit: metres (JRC EFAS flood hazard README v3.1.1, field D10)
